question: We supply FD&C Red No. 4 to cosmetic makers. Under Part 82, what specifications must a batch meet for certification, and is its use restricted?
answer:
1. 
2. FD&C Red No. 4 is restricted to use in externally applied drugs and cosmetics [16]. 
3. 
4. A batch of a straight color listed in subpart B, C, or D shall be certified under this part unless it is free from all impurities (other than those named in paragraph (b) of this section or in the specifications set forth in such paragraph for such color) to the extent that such impurities can be avoided by good manufacturing practice [3]. 
5. 
6. 
7. D&C Blue No. 
8. D&C Blue No. 4 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1104(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter [8]. 
9. D&C Red No. 4 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1304(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter [16]. 
10. D&C Red No.
